name: upstream
plan:
plugin: agentupdate
mode: manual
node_id: node-a
node_name: Node A
current_version: 0.3.3
target_version: 0.3.4
binary_source: upstream
binary_url: https://downloads.example.com/lattice-agent-linux-amd64
sha256: 3f1c5e0a9b8d7c6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b4c3d2e
install_path: /opt/lattice/node-agent/lattice-agent
service_name: lattice-agent.service
resume_download: true

Safety:
- the binary comes from the upstream release, so this node needs egress to it
- import this version under Agent updates to serve it from the control plane instead
- download is HTTPS-only and verified against the pinned SHA-256 digest
- binary is installed atomically with a timestamped backup
- service restart is delayed so the current agent can post the task result
- the download gives up after 20 s without a connection or 480 s in total, so a node without egress to the source fails the task instead of hanging it
- an interrupted download is kept beside the install path as .lattice-agent-download-<sha256>, readable by root only, and the next attempt continues it instead of starting over, so a node too slow to fetch the binary inside one 480 s budget finishes it over successive attempts; the finished file is held to the pinned digest and deleted if it fails, and kept downloads for any other digest are removed first
- default/legacy install targets follow the running lattice-agent path and default service may follow the running systemd unit
- keepalive: a binary that advertises sd-notify-v1 in -compat-json gets the unit drop-in 10-lattice-keepalive.conf (NotifyAccess=main and a runtime directory; the unit type is unchanged), so it can arm its own 120 s watchdog
- update guard: when the new binary also advertises health-marker-v1, a timer restores the previous binary and restarts the service if the new agent has not completed its first hello within 300 s; the timer lives in /run, so a reboot before it fires cancels the guard and keeps the new binary
- execution still requires node-agent -allow-exec and root updates require -allow-root-exec
script:
set -e
umask 077
ulimit -Hf unlimited 2>/dev/null || true
ulimit -Sf unlimited 2>/dev/null || true
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
URL='https://downloads.example.com/lattice-agent-linux-amd64'
BINARY_SOURCE='upstream'
EXPECT_SHA='3f1c5e0a9b8d7c6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b4c3d2e'
TARGET='/opt/lattice/node-agent/lattice-agent'
SERVICE='lattice-agent.service'
TARGET_VERSION='0.3.4'
DEFAULT_TARGET='/opt/lattice/node-agent/lattice-agent'
OLD_DEFAULT_TARGET='/opt/lattice/lattice-agent'
LEGACY_TARGET='/usr/local/bin/lattice-agent'
DEFAULT_SERVICE='lattice-agent.service'
RUNNING_AGENT=""
if [ -r "/proc/$PPID/exe" ]; then
  RUNNING_AGENT=$(readlink -f "/proc/$PPID/exe" 2>/dev/null || readlink "/proc/$PPID/exe" 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
case "$RUNNING_AGENT" in
  */lattice-agent)
    if [ "$TARGET" = "$DEFAULT_TARGET" ] || [ "$TARGET" = "$OLD_DEFAULT_TARGET" ] || [ "$TARGET" = "$LEGACY_TARGET" ]; then TARGET="$RUNNING_AGENT"; fi
    ;;
esac
RUNNING_SERVICE=""
if [ -r "/proc/$PPID/cgroup" ]; then
  RUNNING_SERVICE=$(sed -n 's#.*system\.slice/\([^/]*\.service\).*#\1#p' "/proc/$PPID/cgroup" | head -n 1)
fi
if [ -z "$RUNNING_SERVICE" ] && [ -r /proc/self/cgroup ]; then
  RUNNING_SERVICE=$(sed -n 's#.*system\.slice/\([^/]*\.service\).*#\1#p' /proc/self/cgroup | head -n 1)
fi
if [ -n "$RUNNING_SERVICE" ] && [ "$SERVICE" = "$DEFAULT_SERVICE" ]; then SERVICE="$RUNNING_SERVICE"; fi
echo "lattice agent update: effective target=$TARGET service=$SERVICE binary_source=$BINARY_SOURCE"
if ! command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -d /run/systemd/system ]; then
  echo 'lattice agent update: systemd is required for managed agent updates; refusing to install without a restart manager' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! command -v systemd-run >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'lattice agent update: systemd-run is required to schedule a verified delayed restart' >&2
  exit 1
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
if ! systemctl status "$SERVICE" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! systemctl --no-legend list-unit-files "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -Fxq "$SERVICE"; then
  echo "lattice agent update: service $SERVICE not found before installing $TARGET" >&2
  exit 1
fi
PARTIAL_DIR=$(dirname "$TARGET")
mkdir -p "$PARTIAL_DIR"
CANDIDATE="$PARTIAL_DIR/.lattice-agent-download-$EXPECT_SHA"
for KEPT in "$PARTIAL_DIR"/.lattice-agent-download-*; do
  if [ "$KEPT" != "$CANDIDATE" ]; then rm -rf "$KEPT"; fi
done
if [ -f "$CANDIDATE" ] && [ ! -L "$CANDIDATE" ] && [ -O "$CANDIDATE" ]; then
  chmod 0600 "$CANDIDATE"
  echo "lattice agent update: continuing the download an earlier attempt kept in $CANDIDATE ($(wc -c <"$CANDIDATE") bytes)"
else
  rm -rf "$CANDIDATE"
fi
FETCH_STATUS=0
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 480 -C - -o "$CANDIDATE" "$URL" || FETCH_STATUS=$?
  if [ "$FETCH_STATUS" = 33 ]; then rm -f "$CANDIDATE"; fi
elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  wget --https-only -q --timeout=20 --tries=2 -c -O "$CANDIDATE" "$URL" || FETCH_STATUS=$?
else
  echo 'lattice agent update: curl or wget is required' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$FETCH_STATUS" != 0 ]; then
  if [ -s "$CANDIDATE" ]; then
    echo "lattice agent update: download failed; kept the $(wc -c <"$CANDIDATE") bytes received so far for the next attempt to continue" >&2
  fi
  exit "$FETCH_STATUS"
fi
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ACTUAL_SHA=$(sha256sum "$CANDIDATE" | awk '{print $1}')
elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ACTUAL_SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$CANDIDATE" | awk '{print $1}')
else
  echo 'lattice agent update: sha256sum or shasum is required' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$ACTUAL_SHA" != "$EXPECT_SHA" ]; then
  rm -f "$CANDIDATE"
  echo "lattice agent update: sha256 mismatch expected=$EXPECT_SHA actual=$ACTUAL_SHA; deleted the download so the next attempt starts over" >&2
  exit 1
fi
chmod 0700 "$CANDIDATE"
CANDIDATE_VERSION=$("$CANDIDATE" -version)
if [ "$CANDIDATE_VERSION" != "$TARGET_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "lattice agent update: version mismatch expected=$TARGET_VERSION actual=$CANDIDATE_VERSION" >&2
  exit 1
fi
CANDIDATE_COMPAT=$("$CANDIDATE" -compat-json 2>/dev/null || true)
TIMER_ACCURACY=""
if systemd-run --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- '--timer-property'; then TIMER_ACCURACY='--timer-property=AccuracySec=1s'; fi
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$TARGET")"
BACKUP=""
if [ -e "$TARGET" ]; then
  BACKUP="$TARGET.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
  cp -p "$TARGET" "$BACKUP"
fi
install -m 0755 "$CANDIDATE" "$TARGET.new"
mv "$TARGET.new" "$TARGET"
rm -f "$CANDIDATE"
UNIT_NAME="${SERVICE%.service}"
DROPIN_DIR="/etc/systemd/system/$UNIT_NAME.service.d"
DROPIN="$DROPIN_DIR/10-lattice-keepalive.conf"
KEEPALIVE=0
case "$CANDIDATE_COMPAT" in
  *'"sd-notify-v1"'*)
    KEEPALIVE=1
    mkdir -p "$DROPIN_DIR"
    printf '%s\n' '# Written by the Lattice agent installer or an agent update.' '[Service]' 'NotifyAccess=main' "RuntimeDirectory=$UNIT_NAME" 'RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700' >"$DROPIN.new"
    chmod 0644 "$DROPIN.new"
    mv "$DROPIN.new" "$DROPIN"
    echo "lattice agent update: wrote keepalive drop-in $DROPIN"
    ;;
esac
systemctl daemon-reload
case "$CANDIDATE_COMPAT" in
  *'"health-marker-v1"'*)
    if [ "$KEEPALIVE" = 1 ] && [ -n "$BACKUP" ]; then
      GUARD_UNIT="lattice-agent-update-guard-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$"
      GUARD_FILE="/run/$GUARD_UNIT.sh"
      printf '%s\n' 'trap "rm -f $0" EXIT
  m="$LATTICE_GUARD_MARKER"
  if [ -r "$m" ] && [ "$(cat "$m")" = "$LATTICE_GUARD_VERSION" ]; then
    echo "lattice agent update guard: $LATTICE_GUARD_VERSION completed its first hello, keeping it"
    exit 0
  fi
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then now=$(sha256sum "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET" | cut -d" " -f1); else now=$(shasum -a 256 "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET" | cut -d" " -f1); fi
  if [ "$now" != "$LATTICE_GUARD_SHA" ]; then
    echo "lattice agent update guard: $LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET changed since the update, leaving it"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "lattice agent update guard: $LATTICE_GUARD_VERSION did not complete its first hello in time, restoring $LATTICE_GUARD_BACKUP" >&2
  cp -p "$LATTICE_GUARD_BACKUP" "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET.rollback"
  mv "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET.rollback" "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET"
  systemctl restart "$LATTICE_GUARD_SERVICE"
' >"$GUARD_FILE"
      if ! systemd-run --unit="$GUARD_UNIT" --on-active=300s $TIMER_ACCURACY --description="Lattice agent update guard for $TARGET_VERSION" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET="$TARGET" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_BACKUP="$BACKUP" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_SERVICE="$SERVICE" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_MARKER="/run/$UNIT_NAME/healthy" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_VERSION="$TARGET_VERSION" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_SHA="$EXPECT_SHA" /bin/sh "$GUARD_FILE" >/dev/null; then
        rm -f "$GUARD_FILE"
        cp -p "$BACKUP" "$TARGET.rollback"
        mv "$TARGET.rollback" "$TARGET"
        echo "lattice agent update: could not arm the update guard; restored $BACKUP and left the running agent alone" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      echo "lattice agent update: armed $GUARD_UNIT, which restores $BACKUP unless $TARGET_VERSION completes its first hello within 300s"
    fi
    ;;
esac
RESTART_UNIT="lattice-agent-delayed-restart-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$"
systemd-run --unit="$RESTART_UNIT" --on-active=3s $TIMER_ACCURACY /bin/systemctl restart "$SERVICE" >/dev/null
echo "lattice agent update: installed $TARGET_VERSION and scheduled $SERVICE restart via $RESTART_UNIT"

- default/legacy install targets follow the running lattice-agent path and default service may follow the running systemd unit
- keepalive: a binary that advertises sd-notify-v1 in -compat-json gets the unit drop-in 10-lattice-keepalive.conf (NotifyAccess=main and a runtime directory; the unit type is unchanged), so it can arm its own 120 s watchdog
- update guard: when the new binary also advertises health-marker-v1, a timer restores the previous binary and restarts the service if the new agent has not completed its first hello within 300 s; the timer lives in /run, so a reboot before it fires cancels the guard and keeps the new binary
- execution still requires node-agent -allow-exec and root updates require -allow-root-exec
script:
set -e
umask 077
ulimit -Hf unlimited 2>/dev/null || true
ulimit -Sf unlimited 2>/dev/null || true
PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
URL='https://lattice.example/api/agent/agent-binary/0.3.4/linux/amd64/3f1c5e0a9b8d7c6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b4c3d2e'
FALLBACK_URL='https://downloads.example.com/lattice-agent-linux-amd64'
BINARY_SOURCE='control-plane'
EXPECT_SHA='3f1c5e0a9b8d7c6e5f4a3b2c1d0e9f8a7b6c5d4e3f2a1b0c9d8e7f6a5b4c3d2e'
TARGET='/opt/lattice/node-agent/lattice-agent'
SERVICE='lattice-agent.service'
TARGET_VERSION='0.3.4'
DEFAULT_TARGET='/opt/lattice/node-agent/lattice-agent'
OLD_DEFAULT_TARGET='/opt/lattice/lattice-agent'
LEGACY_TARGET='/usr/local/bin/lattice-agent'
DEFAULT_SERVICE='lattice-agent.service'
RUNNING_AGENT=""
if [ -r "/proc/$PPID/exe" ]; then
  RUNNING_AGENT=$(readlink -f "/proc/$PPID/exe" 2>/dev/null || readlink "/proc/$PPID/exe" 2>/dev/null || true)
fi
case "$RUNNING_AGENT" in
  */lattice-agent)
    if [ "$TARGET" = "$DEFAULT_TARGET" ] || [ "$TARGET" = "$OLD_DEFAULT_TARGET" ] || [ "$TARGET" = "$LEGACY_TARGET" ]; then TARGET="$RUNNING_AGENT"; fi
    ;;
esac
RUNNING_SERVICE=""
if [ -r "/proc/$PPID/cgroup" ]; then
  RUNNING_SERVICE=$(sed -n 's#.*system\.slice/\([^/]*\.service\).*#\1#p' "/proc/$PPID/cgroup" | head -n 1)
fi
if [ -z "$RUNNING_SERVICE" ] && [ -r /proc/self/cgroup ]; then
  RUNNING_SERVICE=$(sed -n 's#.*system\.slice/\([^/]*\.service\).*#\1#p' /proc/self/cgroup | head -n 1)
fi
if [ -n "$RUNNING_SERVICE" ] && [ "$SERVICE" = "$DEFAULT_SERVICE" ]; then SERVICE="$RUNNING_SERVICE"; fi
echo "lattice agent update: effective target=$TARGET service=$SERVICE binary_source=$BINARY_SOURCE"
if ! command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -d /run/systemd/system ]; then
  echo 'lattice agent update: systemd is required for managed agent updates; refusing to install without a restart manager' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! command -v systemd-run >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo 'lattice agent update: systemd-run is required to schedule a verified delayed restart' >&2
  exit 1
fi
systemctl daemon-reload
if ! systemctl status "$SERVICE" >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! systemctl --no-legend list-unit-files "$SERVICE" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' | grep -Fxq "$SERVICE"; then
  echo "lattice agent update: service $SERVICE not found before installing $TARGET" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -z "${LATTICE_TASK_ID:-}" ] || [ -z "${LATTICE_TASK_LEASE_ID:-}" ]; then
  echo 'lattice agent update: this agent does not expose its task lease; control-plane binary distribution needs node-agent v0.2.0 or newer' >&2
  exit 1
fi
PARTIAL_DIR=$(dirname "$TARGET")
mkdir -p "$PARTIAL_DIR"
CANDIDATE="$PARTIAL_DIR/.lattice-agent-download-$EXPECT_SHA"
for KEPT in "$PARTIAL_DIR"/.lattice-agent-download-*; do
  if [ "$KEPT" != "$CANDIDATE" ]; then rm -rf "$KEPT"; fi
done
if [ -f "$CANDIDATE" ] && [ ! -L "$CANDIDATE" ] && [ -O "$CANDIDATE" ]; then
  chmod 0600 "$CANDIDATE"
  echo "lattice agent update: continuing the download an earlier attempt kept in $CANDIDATE ($(wc -c <"$CANDIDATE") bytes)"
else
  rm -rf "$CANDIDATE"
fi
FETCH_STATUS=0
FETCH_START=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
if command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsS --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time 480 -H "X-Lattice-Task-Id: $LATTICE_TASK_ID" -H "X-Lattice-Task-Lease: $LATTICE_TASK_LEASE_ID" -C - -o "$CANDIDATE" "$URL" || FETCH_STATUS=$?
  if [ "$FETCH_STATUS" = 33 ]; then rm -f "$CANDIDATE"; fi
  if [ "$FETCH_STATUS" != 0 ]; then
    FETCH_NOW=$(date +%s 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    case "$FETCH_START:$FETCH_NOW" in
      0:*|*:0|:*|*:|*[!0-9:]*) FETCH_LEFT=$((480 - 20)) ;;
      *) FETCH_LEFT=$((480 - ($FETCH_NOW - $FETCH_START))) ;;
    esac
    if [ "$FETCH_LEFT" -gt 480 ]; then FETCH_LEFT=$((480 - 20)); fi
    if [ "$FETCH_LEFT" -lt 20 ]; then
      echo "lattice agent update: control-plane download failed with ${FETCH_LEFT}s of the 480 s download budget left; not falling back to $FALLBACK_URL" >&2
      FETCH_STATUS=1
    else
      echo "lattice agent update: control-plane download failed; falling back to the release URL $FALLBACK_URL with ${FETCH_LEFT}s left" >&2
      FETCH_STATUS=0
      curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --tlsv1.2 --connect-timeout 20 --max-time "$FETCH_LEFT" -C - -o "$CANDIDATE" "$FALLBACK_URL" || FETCH_STATUS=$?
      if [ "$FETCH_STATUS" = 33 ]; then rm -f "$CANDIDATE"; fi
    fi
  fi
elif command -v wget >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  wget --https-only -q --max-redirect=0 --timeout=20 --tries=2 --header="X-Lattice-Task-Id: $LATTICE_TASK_ID" --header="X-Lattice-Task-Lease: $LATTICE_TASK_LEASE_ID" -c -O "$CANDIDATE" "$URL" || FETCH_STATUS=$?
  if [ "$FETCH_STATUS" != 0 ]; then
    echo "lattice agent update: control-plane download failed; falling back to the release URL $FALLBACK_URL" >&2
    FETCH_STATUS=0
    wget --https-only -q --timeout=20 --tries=2 -c -O "$CANDIDATE" "$FALLBACK_URL" || FETCH_STATUS=$?
  fi
else
  echo 'lattice agent update: curl or wget is required' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$FETCH_STATUS" != 0 ]; then
  if [ -s "$CANDIDATE" ]; then
    echo "lattice agent update: download failed; kept the $(wc -c <"$CANDIDATE") bytes received so far for the next attempt to continue" >&2
  fi
  exit "$FETCH_STATUS"
fi
if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ACTUAL_SHA=$(sha256sum "$CANDIDATE" | awk '{print $1}')
elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ACTUAL_SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$CANDIDATE" | awk '{print $1}')
else
  echo 'lattice agent update: sha256sum or shasum is required' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$ACTUAL_SHA" != "$EXPECT_SHA" ]; then
  rm -f "$CANDIDATE"
  echo "lattice agent update: sha256 mismatch expected=$EXPECT_SHA actual=$ACTUAL_SHA; deleted the download so the next attempt starts over" >&2
  exit 1
fi
chmod 0700 "$CANDIDATE"
CANDIDATE_VERSION=$("$CANDIDATE" -version)
if [ "$CANDIDATE_VERSION" != "$TARGET_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "lattice agent update: version mismatch expected=$TARGET_VERSION actual=$CANDIDATE_VERSION" >&2
  exit 1
fi
CANDIDATE_COMPAT=$("$CANDIDATE" -compat-json 2>/dev/null || true)
TIMER_ACCURACY=""
if systemd-run --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- '--timer-property'; then TIMER_ACCURACY='--timer-property=AccuracySec=1s'; fi
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$TARGET")"
BACKUP=""
if [ -e "$TARGET" ]; then
  BACKUP="$TARGET.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
  cp -p "$TARGET" "$BACKUP"
fi
install -m 0755 "$CANDIDATE" "$TARGET.new"
mv "$TARGET.new" "$TARGET"
rm -f "$CANDIDATE"
UNIT_NAME="${SERVICE%.service}"
DROPIN_DIR="/etc/systemd/system/$UNIT_NAME.service.d"
DROPIN="$DROPIN_DIR/10-lattice-keepalive.conf"
KEEPALIVE=0
case "$CANDIDATE_COMPAT" in
  *'"sd-notify-v1"'*)
    KEEPALIVE=1
    mkdir -p "$DROPIN_DIR"
    printf '%s\n' '# Written by the Lattice agent installer or an agent update.' '[Service]' 'NotifyAccess=main' "RuntimeDirectory=$UNIT_NAME" 'RuntimeDirectoryMode=0700' >"$DROPIN.new"
    chmod 0644 "$DROPIN.new"
    mv "$DROPIN.new" "$DROPIN"
    echo "lattice agent update: wrote keepalive drop-in $DROPIN"
    ;;
esac
systemctl daemon-reload
case "$CANDIDATE_COMPAT" in
  *'"health-marker-v1"'*)
    if [ "$KEEPALIVE" = 1 ] && [ -n "$BACKUP" ]; then
      GUARD_UNIT="lattice-agent-update-guard-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$"
      GUARD_FILE="/run/$GUARD_UNIT.sh"
      printf '%s\n' 'trap "rm -f $0" EXIT
  m="$LATTICE_GUARD_MARKER"
  if [ -r "$m" ] && [ "$(cat "$m")" = "$LATTICE_GUARD_VERSION" ]; then
    echo "lattice agent update guard: $LATTICE_GUARD_VERSION completed its first hello, keeping it"
    exit 0
  fi
  if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then now=$(sha256sum "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET" | cut -d" " -f1); else now=$(shasum -a 256 "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET" | cut -d" " -f1); fi
  if [ "$now" != "$LATTICE_GUARD_SHA" ]; then
    echo "lattice agent update guard: $LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET changed since the update, leaving it"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "lattice agent update guard: $LATTICE_GUARD_VERSION did not complete its first hello in time, restoring $LATTICE_GUARD_BACKUP" >&2
  cp -p "$LATTICE_GUARD_BACKUP" "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET.rollback"
  mv "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET.rollback" "$LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET"
  systemctl restart "$LATTICE_GUARD_SERVICE"
' >"$GUARD_FILE"
      if ! systemd-run --unit="$GUARD_UNIT" --on-active=300s $TIMER_ACCURACY --description="Lattice agent update guard for $TARGET_VERSION" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_TARGET="$TARGET" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_BACKUP="$BACKUP" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_SERVICE="$SERVICE" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_MARKER="/run/$UNIT_NAME/healthy" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_VERSION="$TARGET_VERSION" --setenv=LATTICE_GUARD_SHA="$EXPECT_SHA" /bin/sh "$GUARD_FILE" >/dev/null; then
        rm -f "$GUARD_FILE"
        cp -p "$BACKUP" "$TARGET.rollback"
        mv "$TARGET.rollback" "$TARGET"
        echo "lattice agent update: could not arm the update guard; restored $BACKUP and left the running agent alone" >&2
        exit 1
      fi
      echo "lattice agent update: armed $GUARD_UNIT, which restores $BACKUP unless $TARGET_VERSION completes its first hello within 300s"
    fi
    ;;
esac
RESTART_UNIT="lattice-agent-delayed-restart-$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$"
systemd-run --unit="$RESTART_UNIT" --on-active=3s $TIMER_ACCURACY /bin/systemctl restart "$SERVICE" >/dev/null
echo "lattice agent update: installed $TARGET_VERSION and scheduled $SERVICE restart via $RESTART_UNIT"
